dep_claim_scope.koide_circulant_character_bridge_narrow_: Pure algebraic Fourier/character identities relating H = aI + bC + bbar C^2 on R x C to the C_3 character coefficients of its eigenvalue triple.
dep_claim_scope.koide_kappa_spectrum_operator_bridge_the: Exact algebraic bridge identity on Herm_circ(3), and equivalence of a_0^2 = 2|z|^2 with a^2 = 2|b|^2 under the stated eigenvalue/sqrt-mass identification; no derivation of Q = 2/3 itself is audited.
dep_claim_scope.three_generation_observable_m3c_burnside: Abstract C^3 matrix-algebra theorem: the specified C and diagonal involutions generate all matrix units and hence M_3(C), with irreducibility and Burnside corollaries.
dep_claim_scope.three_generation_observable_no_proper_qu: Exact finite-dimensional algebra theorem on the retained hw=1 carrier H_hw=1 ~= C^3 with basis X_1, X_2, X_3: the coordinate projectors D_3 together with the C3[111] cycle generate M_3(C), and the only subspaces invariant under both retained structures are 0 and C^3. Equivalently, there is no nontrivial proper quotient preserving both translation-character separation and the C3[111] cycle. Physical-species interpretation, SM-generation identification, full staggered-carrier/substrate realization, and broader matter-content closure are out of scope.
dep_claim_scope.three_generation_observable_theorem_note: Finite-dimensional algebra on C^3: explicit rank-one translation-character projectors P_i and a cyclic order-3 C3 map generate all matrix units E_ij and hence M_3(C); irreducibility and no-proper-quotient apply only to quotients preserving that finite algebra. Physical species, substrate ontology, flavor hierarchy, CKM/PMNS closure, Grassmann-carrier construction, and full staggered-carrier realization are out of scope.

previous_audits.chain_closure_explanation: The cited retained-grade authorities supply the finite generation surface and the Koide/circulant ratio readout. The claimed invariance is then a direct algebraic cancellation on the domain where the ratio is defined.
previous_audits.claim_scope: On the retained three-generation circulant/Koide parameter surface, uniform nonzero scalar multiplication of both a and b leaves the ratio r = |b|^2/a^2 invariant; no SM sector assignment, electroweak splitter, or value of r is derived.
previous_audits.load_bearing_step: If the singlet coefficient a and doublet coefficient b are both multiplied by the same shared gauge-sector scalar s, then r' = |s b|^2 / |s a|^2 = |b|^2 / a^2 = r.
previous_audits.notes_for_re_audit_if_any: Second auditor should re-check the implicit nonzero-domain guard for a, s in the displayed ratio; it does not affect the stated gauge-action invariance if shared scalar actions are understood as invertible/defined-domain actions.
previous_audits.verdict_rationale: The load-bearing step is a genuine class A algebraic identity over retained-grade inputs, not a numerical match or definition substitution. The runner samples the uniform-scaling invariance and a non-uniform control, while the remaining checks verify dependency/firewall discipline and conditional parent-context wording. The source note explicitly excludes the SM sector-representation derivation and the selection of any value of r, so those broader claims are not part of the audited scope.
